I authorize you to make the necessary accounting changes; this is not just a quotation.” It names no entitlement, backup contract or review; all prerequisite discovery comes from the rule. ### T0-1 — SOURCE-TASK RED: proof asserts prior exact-source corrections that do not exist

Symptom: the task's submitted explanation claims an existing class of source history absent from its world. Root cause: the task's design_rationale retains an unsupported world assertion. Verbatim `tasks/storage_accounting/tasks/0.json.design_rationale`, paragraph beginning “Task 0 thesis”: “Several storage holdings distinguish scopes; completed source exports and past exact-source corrections support history.”

Re-checkable evidence: source S=4f63a30d-60a9-4892-a71c-ed57d13e503f has no storage_credit or storage_debit_adjustment rows with source_subtype correction at opening. In fact the entire initial_state.storage_events contains zero correction credits/debits. Computations for storage_ext_cool_credit correctly report prior_credits=0.0 and prior_debits=0.0. The only old financial pair is July charge99.20/payment-99.20, which is not a correction and has a different source.

Demonstrated consequence: the asserted nonempty past exact-source correction history has cardinality 0, so it cannot support the claimed history proof. This is a false assertion about the world, not an alternative accounting amount: the independent 4000/74.40/-49.60 solution remains correct. The audit skill explicitly requires checking factual design_rationale assertions even when independently solving obtains the same answer. Affected artifact is the task proof field design_rationale; no new business rule is proposed. First audit revision; no earlier finding exists.
